findings.problem: The proof turns θ : L ⧸ Z(L) ≃* R into a surjection ψ : L →* R with ker ψ ≤ Z(L). It then feeds that to GGCenterPrime. This is not a one-line unfolding: it needs surjectivity of θ∘mk', an injectivity argument for θ, and `QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff` to get the kernel bound. The same construction is rewritten inline elsewhere. KGLangS1EModel.lean lines 114-125 repeat the whole chain (`hcp K (θ.toMonoidHom.comp (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.center K))) ... hcomm`, then the `mem_ker`, `θ.injective`, `eq_one_iff` block) to prove `¬ 3 ∣ Nat.card (Subgroup.center K)`. GGCompListMarked.lean lines 21-29 and many RankThree/Sec4 files rebuild the same π, `hπ` and `hker`. Ready-made pieces already exist but are not used here: `centerQuotMap`, `centerQuotMap_surjective` and `ker_centerQuotMap` in CFSG/Sporadic/Recognition/CoverRecipe.lean, and `ker_centralQuotient` in Item4Res6ProofSeitzCover.lean.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma next to the definition of GGCenterPrime (GGInnLocalDefs.lean), or a file both users import:

theorem GGCenterPrime.not_dvd_center_of_quot {p : ℕ} {R : Type} [Group R] (hcp : GGCenterPrime p R) {L : Type} [Group L] [Finite L] (θ : L ⧸ Subgroup.center L ≃* R) (hperf : commutator L = ⊤) : ¬ p ∣ Nat.card (Subgroup.center L)

Proof: apply `hcp L (θ.toMonoidHom.comp (QuotientGroup.mk' _))`. Surjectivity is `θ.surjective.comp (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _)`. The kernel bound is `(ker_centerQuotMap θ).le` if the CoverRecipe lemma is imported or moved, or else the existing 4-line `mem_ker`/`θ.injective`/`eq_one_iff` argument, written once.

Target use: `dispAux_centerPrime_contra θ hperf h3 hCP` becomes `hCP.not_dvd_center_of_quot θ hperf h3`, so the declaration can be deleted. In `dispAux_classical` and the E6/E7/E8/F4 cases, `dispAux_centerPrime_contra θ hperf (dispAux_three_dvd_center ..) hCP` becomes `(hCP.not_dvd_center_of_quot θ hperf) (dispAux_three_dvd_center ..)`.

KGLangS1EModel use: lines 114-125 become `have hZ : ¬ 3 ∣ Nat.card (Subgroup.center K) := (ExcSplitL.ggCenterPrime_recipe_E7 (f := n) hn hK₁ (p := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).not_dvd_center_of_quot θ hcomm`.
findings.benefit: The surjection-and-kernel construction is stated and proved once instead of being re-derived in each place that applies GGCenterPrime to a centre quotient. The private 13-line helper disappears and the KGLangS1EModel block shrinks to one term. Future fixes, such as changing `Finite` or `Type` universe assumptions, happen in one place.

findings.problem: The four exceptional-Chevalley cases repeat the same proof skeleton. Each one: (i) proves `lab = ⟨.X, lab.rank, 1⟩` by `obtain ⟨t, r, m⟩ := lab; simp_all`; (ii) rewrites and unfolds `LargeEvenRawDatum`/`LargeEvenRecipeChevalley`; (iii) destructs `⟨K, hKf, hKfin, hKcard, -, -, θ, -, -, -⟩`; (iv) installs `letI : Field K` and `letI : Finite K`; (v) in E7/E8/F4, derives `CharP K 2`; (vi) closes with `dispAux_centerPrime_contra θ hperf (dispAux_three_dvd_center hS hxL) (<recipe lemma>)`. Only the Cartan matrix and the recipe lemma differ. The `lab = ⟨tag, rank, 1⟩` normalisation by `simp_all` also appears in the twA case, so it is written five times in total. Extracting K and θ from a Chevalley raw datum is the non-trivial common part, and it is copy-pasted rather than proved once.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one private lemma stated on the recipe, not the label:

private theorem dispAux_chevalley_contra {G} [Group G] [Finite G] {B Bs} {x} {L D J} (hS : GGQTwoSetting 3 B Bs x L D J) (hxL : x ∈ L) (hperf : commutator ↥L = ⊤) {r} {A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℤ} (hraw : LargeEvenRecipeChevalley A (2 ^ 1) false (fun R _ I F => IsSimpleGroup R ∧ (∃ a b : R, a * b ≠ b * a) ∧ ∃ θ : ↥L ⧸ Subgroup.center ↥L ≃* R, GGLabQTwo 3 lab ∧ Bs ≤ ... ∧ ∀ b ∈ Bs, ...)) (hCP : ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Finite K] [CharP K 2], Nat.card K = 2 ^ 1 → GGCenterPrime 3 (LargeEvenCenterQuot (LargeEvenChevH A K false))) : False

Proof sketch: `obtain ⟨K, hKf, hKfin, hKcard, -, -, θ, -, -, -⟩ := hraw`, install the `letI`s, derive `CharP K 2` once with `charP_two_of_card`, then `exact dispAux_centerPrime_contra θ hperf (dispAux_three_dvd_center hS hxL) (hCP K hKcard)`. Add a small lemma `LargeEvenLabel.eq_mk_of_tag_n (h : lab.tag = t) (hn : lab.n = 1) : lab = ⟨t, lab.rank, 1⟩`, proved once by `obtain ⟨t', r, m⟩ := lab; simp_all`, for use in the twA and exceptional cases.

Rewritten cases: E7 becomes `rw [eq_mk_of_tag_n htag hlabn] at hraw; exact (dispAux_chevalley_contra hS hxL hperf hraw fun K _ _ _ hK => ExcSplitL.ggCenterPrime_recipe_E7 (f := 1) le_rfl hK Nat.prime_three (by norm_num)).elim`. E8 and F4 use `ExcSplitL.ggCenterPrime_recipe_E8 Nat.prime_three (by norm_num)` and `ExcSplitL.ggCenterPrime_recipe_F4 Nat.prime_three (by norm_num)`. E6 uses `ggCenterPrime_recipe_E6_two (by simpa using hK) Nat.prime_three`.
findings.benefit: Each exceptional case shrinks from about 12 lines to about 3. The dispatch then shows the only mathematical difference between cases, which is the center-prime fact used for each family. A change to the datum shape, such as the field-cardinality convention, is made once instead of four times.
